fixes.release_resolution: Seven initially rejected sources loaded successfully after selecting only playable alternatives listed by Spotify metadata, enforcing exact resolved playback identity, and retaining requested identity. Requested/resolved URIs are recorded per source.
fixes.tempo_spread_warning: Runtime metadata agrees with the warning threshold: p98/p02 of local 32-beat BPM >1.6 flags Teardrop, Tarantula, Master of Puppets and Take Five. Changes can be musical or a pulse interpretation error.
fixes.cache_variants: Relinked releases refresh automatic timing/envelopes while retaining explicit manual metadata; tests passed.

known_limitations: Take Five produces four-beat bars despite its known 5/4 meter. The decoder supports whole-track 3/4 candidates only, not arbitrary meter changes or other odd meters.
Model confidence is uncalibrated; finite ordered event arrays and exact native sync do not establish acoustic beat/downbeat correctness, phrase boundaries, or rekordbox parity.

A stable octave interpretation can pass the spread warning. Lose Yourself has a substantial 32-beat tempo spread below the 1.6 threshold, so bpm_ambiguous:false is not permission to skip passage review.

native_launch_sync_check_method.phase_error_definition: Wrap B beat_position minus A beat_position into [-0.5,0.5); relative to effective detected grids, not acoustic annotations.
